questions.question: Which nations does Ezekiel 25 pronounce judgment against?
Why was Ammon judged?
options: For gloating when the sanctuary was profaned
For making a treaty with the great king of Egypt
For refusing to send aid during the famine
For worshiping idols of wood and stone
questions.answer: For gloating when the sanctuary was profaned

questions.question: The repeated purpose was that these nations would know that he is the LORD.
Because you said, 'Aha!' over my sanctuary when it was profaned, I am handing you over to the people of the _____.
I will take my vengeance on _____ by the hand of my people Israel.
